<function name="SetHeight" parent="DModelSelect" type="panelfunc">
	<description>
Sets the height of the panel **in the amount of 64px spawnicons**.

Overrides <page>Panel:SetHeight</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="num" type="number" default="2">Basically how many rows of 64x64 px spawnicons should fit in this DModelSelect</arg>
	</args>
</function>
